dict.title: Web search
dict.description: Set up the DeepSeek search provider.
dict.useSearchApi: Use the new Web Search API
dict.useSearchApiHint: Off by default: search runs through DeepSeek Messages. For the new Web Search API's features and pricing, see the
dict.apiKeyHint: Stored outside the settings file. Leave blank to keep the current key.
dict.apiKeyUnset: No key is configured; only conversations using a DeepSeek Account model can search, through the default endpoint.
dict.baseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the provider default.
dict.searchApiBaseUrlHint: Include the API prefix, such as https://api.deepseek.com/v1/tools. The provider appends /search or /fetch. Leave blank to restore the default.
dict.maxUsesHint: How many times one request may search before it must answer.
dict.countHint: Results returned per query: an integer from 1 to 50, default 10. This controls result count, not search calls. web_search keeps no more sources than its own result limit.
dict.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
dict.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
dict.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
dict.invalidCount: Enter an integer from 1 to 50, or leave blank to use the default.
